Using \(M=(t^2,2t)\) on \(y^2=4x\), we have
\[
|MF|=x+1=t^2+1.
\]
Thus minimize
\[
f(t)=\sqrt{(t^2-3)^2+(2t-1)^2}+t^2+1.
\]
Differentiate:
\[
f'(t)=\frac{2t^3-2t-2}{\sqrt{(t^2-3)^2+(2t-1)^2}}+2t.
\]
Set \(f'(t)=0\):
\[
t^3-t-1=-t\sqrt{(t^2-3)^2+(2t-1)^2}.
\]
Squaring:
\[
(t^3-t-1)^2=t^2\big((t^2-3)^2+(2t-1)^2\big),
\]
so
\[
2t^3-9t^2+2t+1=0=(2t-1)(t^2-4t-1).
\]
The candidates are \(t=\frac12,2\pm\sqrt5\), but only \(t=\frac12\) satisfies the original unsquared equation.

Thus the minimum occurs at \(M=\left(\frac14,1\right)\), giving
\[
|MP|+|MF|=\frac{11}{4}+\frac54=4.
\]
\[
\boxed{4}
\]
